subject: Developer Office Hours — RSVP cadence, tracking links, and fallback plan
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Developer Office Hours — RSVP cadence, tracking links, and fallback plan

Team —

Putting together the final outbound plan for the Oct 14 Developer Office Hours. High-level asks: copy signoff, final target list segments, tracking link mapping, and a fallback plan if the RSVP landing page is throttled. I attached the current assets pack (invite_email_assets_v3.zip) and a draft CSV of link mappings.

Quick summary of proposed cadence (PST):
- Invite: Tue, Oct 5 10:00am PT — send to full target list (segments A/B)
- Reminder 1: Thu, Oct 7 10:00am PT — condensed copy, add case study line for enterprise list
- Reminder 2 (24h): Wed, Oct 13 10:00am PT — last chance subject variant
- Day-of (3 hrs): Wed, Oct 14 8:00am PT local -> short-reminder sequences by timezone (see mapping below)

Target segments (short):
- Segment A: Developers / platform engineers (high cadence, shorter subject)
- Segment B: Application/product teams (longer copy, include cost/perf blurb)
- Segment C: Embedded/customers (personalized invite from CS + cohost blurb from Acme)

Tracking link plan (high level):
- Each segment gets unique UTM + variant param (e.g., utm_segment=A & variant=short)
- Use short.redwood/event/* as the public short link, which will redirect to hubspot landing with full UTM chain.
- Fallthrough: if short.redwood is rate-limited, fallback to hubspot direct links in the email as secondary hrefs (note: we should prioritize the short link in the CTA and include a text link to the hubspot URL in the postscript).

Open items / asks: please respond with the following by EOD Fri (Oct 1):
- Marissa: confirm final subject + two preview text options and which variant for Segment A vs B
- Olga: confirm landing page slug and make sure the HubSpot campaign is live; share the canonical hubspot URL and form ID
- Karthik: produce final tracking-link CSV and short.link list (for DNS allocation)
- Jordan: are we ok to include the Acme cohost blurb as-is? Katelyn agreed in principle but wants to confirm wording.

Attachments: invite_email_assets_v3.zip (html + images), tracking-link-map-202610.csv

Thanks —
Sergio
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Developer Office Hours — RSVP cadence, tracking links, and fallback plan

Sergio —

Quick answers and copy variants below. Leaning on Variant B for Segment A (short). For Segment B we'll run Variant C (longer, benefit-driven).

Suggested subject lines (pick one per segment):
A. "Dev Office Hours — Bring your performance questions (Oct 14)"
B. "How top teams cut inference cost — Office Hours Oct 14"
C. "Ask our engineers: optimizing LLM inference for production"

Preview texts (2 options):
1) "Live Q&A with Redwood engineers — practical tips for low-latency inference."
2) "Bring your prompts and performance metrics — we'll walk through configs live."

Short copy for Segment A (Variant B):
Hi {first_name},
Join our Dev Office Hours on Oct 14 — quick demos, KV cache tips, and Q&A with our runtime team. RSVP to reserve your spot.
CTA: Reserve my seat → short.redwood/event/dev-hours-2026?utm_segment=A&variant=short

Long copy for Segment B (Variant C):
Hi {first_name},
If you're responsible for inference at scale, join Redwood engineers to discuss batching, quantization trade-offs, and routing policies that reduce per-token cost without regressing quality. We'll share concrete configs and a live troubleshooting slot.
CTA: Save my spot → short.redwood/event/dev-hours-2026?utm_segment=B&variant=long

Two tiny notes:
- Add a P.S. line for Acme co-host: "Co-hosted with Acme Data — bring architecture questions for our special guest."
- For accessibility, include full hubspot link below the button as fallback.

I'll attach the final HTML snippets by EOD today.

—Marissa
Director, Demand Gen
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Developer Office Hours — RSVP cadence, tracking links, and fallback plan

Thanks — updated ops checklist below. I've created the landing page draft and set the HubSpot campaign (ID 9876543). HubSpot canonical URL and form info: https://hubspot.redwood.com/l/dev-office-hours-2026 (form id 3742). Please use the canonical URL as the fallback after the short link.

Ops checklist (owner):
- Landing page live (Olga) — slug: /l/dev-office-hours-2026 — completed (draft)
- HubSpot form ID 3742 (Olga) — completed
- Short link batch (Karthik) — pending; need final CSV to provision 6 short links for A/B + reminders
- Email assets (Marissa) — please send final HTML + alt images by EOD Fri
- Load test: I will run a lightweight smoke test against short.redwood and the hubspot redirect on Mon Oct 5 at 09:30 PT — will report throttling signs

Reminder send timing by timezone (final):
- PST batch send times as above
- For EMEA/APAC registrants we will use localized day/time windows; Jordan please confirm localized subject for APAC if needed.

Attachments: none in this reply.

All — finalizing and locking things down after Katelyn's note. Deliverables below (I've updated the shared CSV in Drive and provisioned short links). Everything is ready to hand to marketing ops for the Oct 5 invite send at 10:00am PT.

Provisioned short links (public):
- short.redwood/event/dev-hours-2026?utm_segment=A&variant=short (A - dev short) -> srv01.redwood/lnk/1a2b
- short.redwood/event/dev-hours-2026?utm_segment=B&variant=long (B - product) -> srv01.redwood/lnk/1a2c
- short.redwood/event/dev-hours-2026?utm_segment=C&variant=corp (C - customers) -> srv01.redwood/lnk/1a2d
- Reminder variants (R1/R2) mapped similarly in tracking-link-map-202610.csv

Send schedule final (PST):
- Invite (all segments): Tue Oct 5 10:00am PT (note: Olga will run smoke test at 09:30)
- Reminder 1: Thu Oct 7 10:00am PT
- Reminder 2: Tue Oct 13 10:00am PT
- Day-of 3hr reminder: Wed Oct 14 08:00am local time windows

Fallback plan (if short.redwood DNS/rate limit detected):
- CTA primary uses the short link; fallback shows the full hubspot URL below the CTA and the button's secondary href points to the hubspot canonical.
- If short.redwood returns errors > 5% in the smoke test, we'll switch the button href to hubspot canonical and append parameter fallback=true to the hubspot URL to track fallbacks.

Next steps: Olga to confirm smoke test results; Marissa to upload final HTML to Drive; Sergio to give final approval for co-host blurb; Jordan to confirm localized subjects for APAC batch.

Thanks —
Karthik
Marketing Ops
